text:
Maya K: Quick thread for the compare UX follow-up. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW2. Main points: filter persistence, badge copy+contrast, compare row density, and version-locking affordance.

Noah D: Mock looks good. Quick wins: make primary filters sticky in the rail (family, quant) and fold the rest into a collapsed "More filters" drawer with a count. Persist filter state in the URL so links are shareable.

Ivy L: Density note: users want predictable row heights. Instead of toggling DOM rows, expose three presets (Comfort / Compact / Dense) and map them to CSS vars. This keeps virtualization stable. Small code sample: `:root{--row-h:64px} [data-density=compact]{--row-h:48px}`.

Rita P: Badge semantics: stop using generic "perf". Show explicit pills: "Latency (ms)", "Cost ($/1k)", and optional "Throughput". Tooltips should show p50/p90 and an estimated token cost. Also the purple badge fails contrast at small sizes 12px12 - move to darker hex.

Maya K: Pin wording: prefer "Lock version" (verb) and show scope under the control: "Local to this comparison" (default) with an overflow option "Apply to all comparisons". After locking show an undo snackbar.

Noah D: Mobile behavior: collapse badges to a single chip e.g., "L:85ms" with chevron to expand details. For pin confirmation on mobile use a small popover with role=dialog and focus trap.

Ivy L: Accessibility: make badges keyboard-focusable and use `aria-describedby` to point at tooltip content. For screen readers read as "Latency, p90 210 milliseconds". Also ensure focus outlines are visible at all densities.

ui-bot: Feature flag `catalog_compare_lock_flow_v2` created in staging. Use `/ff catalog_compare_lock_flow_v2 on` to opt in.

Rita P: Dev plan: URL-encoded filters, density presets via CSS vars, darker badge tokens, lock endpoint `POST /api/compare/lock` with scope, and telemetry events: `compare.locked`, `compare.lock_undo`, `compare.density_change`.

Maya K: Thanks. I'll schedule a short review Monday 10am to sign off copy and accessibility fixes. I'll attach mocks and acceptance criteria. :white_check_mark:
